Name: Darker Demetrius and Sebastian Edits for Seasonal SDV Outfit Nyapu Style Retextures
Author: addioangel
Description:
[size=3]Contains two separate files for both Demetrius and Sebastian. You can choose either or both.[/size]
Feel free to post any questions you may have under the comments tab <3

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
- Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255]SEASONAL SDV OUTFITS NYAPU STYLE RETEXTURES[/url] along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong[/url]
- Find Demetrius and/or Sebastian's portrait PNGs in both the listed mods, open up each sub-folder and drag the new images into their respective mods (drag images from Nyapu Portraits into the Nyapu Portraits mod/Seasonal Retextures into Seasonal Retextures mod, etc.) , now let them replace the previous ones.
- Finished!

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]You HAVE to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255]SEASONAL SDV OUTFITS NYAPU STYLE RETEXTURES[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong[/url] for these to work. They do nothing on their own.[/color]
